newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet, AT&T in bid for Brazil phones.
newsitem.headline: Stet, AT&T in bid for Brazil phones.

text.p: Italy's state-controlled telecoms holding Stet confirmed on Wednesday it would take part together with AT&T Corp in a bid for the privatisation of cellular phones in Brazil.

"We consider it is important to have a high-profile partner to take part in the Brazil cellular phone bidding," managing director Tomaso Tommasi di Vignano told reporters after appearing before a parliamentary commission.
Asked if the accord with AT&T heralded a broader alliance, Tommasi said: "The omens are always positive."

AT&T last month declined comment on Italian press reports that a broad-based alliance with Stet was imminent. Stet denied the reports but said the group was in continuous contact with several foreign telecoms groups.
